title: Libraries and PHP extensions downloaded manually by install-php-extensions

libraries.description: Keys are the suffixes of the IPE_LIBVERSION_... variables defined in install-php-extensions

usedBy.description: The PHP extensions that use the library

extensions.description: Keys are the names of the PHP extensions (the IPE_EXTLATESTVERSION_<EXTENSION> variables defined in install-php-extensions)

name.description: The name of the library/source (it's also used to identify the notified updates)

url.description: The URL where maintainers can check the new versions

skipCheck.description: Why we don't check for new versions

latestVersion.description: How to retrieve the latest version

timeout.description: The maximum number of seconds for the connection and for the download

oneOf.description: The highest stable version among the tags of a git repository

ignoreTags.description: Regular expression of the tags to be ignored

oneOf.description: The commit hash a git ref (branch) points to

The highest version extracted from a web page with a regular expression: the version is the "version" named group (or the first capturing group); if there's a "suffix" named group, its value is appended to the version (<version>@<suffix>)
